sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 02.10.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 18.10.2022.

The following arguments made by Mrs. Swati Agrawal Srivastava, learned counsel assisted by Mr.
Amit Kumar, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Mr. Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. Learned counsel for the applicant contests the minority of the victim as depicted in the prosecution case.
2. The victim was wrongly shown as a minor of 16 years in the F.I.R. only to falsely implicate the applicant under the stringent provisions of the POCSO Act and cause his imprisonment.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant contests the age of the victim set out in the prosecution case in light of the judgement of this Court in Monish Vs. State of U.P.
and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021) and on the following grounds:
(i) There are material contradictions in the age of the victim as recorded in various prosecution documents.
(ii) The age of the victim was incorrectly got registered in the school records by the victim's parents to give her an advantage in life.

sentences.text: The school records disclosing her age as 13 years are unreliable.
(iii) The victim in her statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. has stated that she is 12 years and 14 years of age respectively.
(iv) The medical report drawn up to determine the age of the victim opines that she is 18 years of age.
In fact the victim is a major.
4. The victim and the applicant were intimate.
5. The victim sent intimate photographs with the applicant from her own mobile.
6. No indecent photographs or videos of the victim were captured by the applicant nor were they circulated by him.
7. Indecent videos or photographs have not been recovered from the applicant.
8. Medical evidence to corroborate the commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.

sentences.text: The applicant is a law abiding citizen who cooperated with the police investigations and had joined the trial.
10. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
11. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Sarvesh Kumar Srivastava be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number,
on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Before parting, this Court would like to observe that the case diary has recorded that the Id's of the Instagram account from where the indecent photograph of the victim was circulated on the social media has not been recovered.
The chain of electronic evidence against the applicant could not be completed in the absence of the Id details of the account.
This reflects rather a poor and callous state of the investigation on the part of the District police authorities.

It also depicts an abject failure of the police authorities to work in tandem with the various service providers and extract the relevant electronic evidences from such service providers who are known to everybody.
Despite repeated orders by this Court, the poor quality of investigations in IT related offences is not improving.
This is a matter of serious concern.

On the past occasion, this Court has directed the Director General of Police, Government of U.P. to take notice of this deficiency in the police functioning but apparently words of this Court have fallen down.

A copy of this order be placed before the Additional Chief Secretary (Home), Government of U.P. for appropriate action as per law to ensure that appropriate systematic changes are affected in the police force to ensure that the investigation in IT related offences are conducted by duly trained personnel with highest levels of proficiency.
The police should also have requisite methods to extract data which is available with the service provider and digital media platforms.
